scope: External M/S diagnostic replication only. This is not a geometry, modal, META-DYNAMICS, or cross-branch analysis.

hypothesis.name: paderborn_vibration_ms_three_class_diagnostic
hypothesis.claim: A pre-registered M/S feature vector from vibration_1 separates healthy, artificial outer-ring EDM, and artificial inner-ring EDM classes above a fixed held-out baseline.
hypothesis.role: diagnostic classifier, not a fault selector or production protection function

input.file_payload_access_after_this_preregist: authorized only for the members listed in PADERBORN_MS_REPLICATION_v0.1

windowing.rule: four contiguous, non-overlapping windows [0,1), [1,2), [2,3), [3,4) seconds from every selected four-second measurement
windowing.split_unit: entire MATLAB measurement file; windows never cross train/calibration/holdout boundaries

M/S: anomaly_rate: fraction of samples whose robust healthy-train z-score exceeds 3 in absolute value
defect_rate: fraction of first differences whose robust healthy-train z-score exceeds 3 in absolute value
resonance_M_rate: fraction of 20 ms blocks containing at least three anomaly samples
signal_twist_rate: rate of sign reversals of the first difference after robust thresholding

fitting.model: train-standardized nearest-centroid classifier on four M/S features
fitting.normalization: medians and MAD scales from healthy train windows only; zero MAD is replaced by 1.0
fitting.no_tuning: No feature, threshold, window, classifier, or split modification after calibration or holdout access.

controls.positive: Add deterministic sparse impulses to copies of healthy train windows; anomaly_rate and defect_rate must both increase relative to their originals.
controls.negative: Permute calibration labels with fixed seed 20260920; resulting macro-F1 must be at most 0.40.
controls.gate: If either control fails, holdout verdict is INCONCLUSIVE.

evaluation.calibration_use: one technical check only; it may not modify the plan
evaluation.holdout_metric: macro-F1 across the three classes, aggregated at measurement-file level by majority vote of its four window predictions
evaluation.supported_if: both controls pass AND holdout macro-F1 >= 0.60 AND holdout macro-F1 minus fixed-seed permuted-label macro-F1 >= 0.20
evaluation.not_supported_if: both controls pass but one or both supported criteria fail
evaluation.inconclusive_if: a control fails, required channel metadata is absent, or frozen data integrity cannot be verified

holdout_policy: No holdout payload may be read before an explicit one-time evaluation command is authorized after implementation and tests are committed.
limitations: The source is a laboratory benchmark, not an operational industrial deployment.
Only artificial EDM defects are represented in the two damaged classes.
A successful outcome would not establish a TIMDR cross-branch bridge or general production performance.
